macc_paradise_0.text: Paradise Mill. Brick, windows and clatter. These handlooms were working right up until 1981.
The Jacquard loom reads its pattern from a chain of punched cards. A hole means a thread lifts. It is a computer made of wood.
A weaver on a very fine pattern might finish only a few inches in a day. Silk rewards patience, and punishes sneezing.
